description: This file contains helper functions for managing taints on Kubernetes nodes, including adding, updating, removing taints, and patching node objects via Kubernetes API calls.

methods.name: AddOrUpdateTaintOnNode
methods.description: Adds or updates taints on a specified node, issuing API calls if changes are made.

methods.name: PatchNodeTaints
methods.description: Patches the taints of a node object in Kubernetes API.

methods.name: addOrUpdateTaint
methods.description: Creates a copy of the node with an added or updated taint if necessary.

methods.name: RemoveTaintOffNode
methods.description: Removes specified taints from a node, with optional API call if taints are present.

methods.name: taintExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific taint exists in a list of taints.

methods.name: removeTaint
methods.description: Removes a specific taint from a node copy if it exists.

methods.name: deleteTaint
methods.description: Deletes all taints matching the key and effect of a given taint.
